current.text: Experts agree his ESPN rank is too high. One says not to draft him at ESPN's rank of 7th, and he has never played near that level.
His fair value is about a Yahoo rank of 26, a round 3 pick in category leagues. A Fantrax ADP of 34 to 36 is fair to good value.
In one expert's drafts he often goes later than his ADP.
In an auction mock he went for 24 USD. The expert expected the mid 20s and called 24 USD too cheap.
The experts are split on how much to like him. One is not a big fan this year, and another regrets not bidding at 24 USD.
Giannis Antetokounmpo joined Miami in a trade. Bam, Giannis and Andrew Wiggins are locks to start.
Giannis should cost him a small amount of value, mostly some rebounds, and may push him to take more threes. Experts expect no big drop because Miami lost a lot of other talent.
He shot poorly last season, including about 29% from three over the final 25 games.
His shooting is expected to improve this season.
His assists rose to about 4.5 per game over the final 15 to 20 games of last season.
He has not been blocking shots. Next to Giannis he may do more rim protection.
Miami's backup center depth is poor, with Nick Richards and Vlad Goldin behind him.
With the March 28 end, Miami has a weak 4-3-3 schedule in our playoff weeks, 10 games in total. Miami also has the league-minimum 13 back-to-backs.
The East is very stacked, so Miami may not be able to rest players for long stretches.
He ranks 20th in Yahoo points leagues and is a late round 2 pick there, compared with round 3 in category leagues.

durable.text: His FG% is weak for a big on real volume, at about 44.6% on about 16 attempts per game. This is his clear weak category.
He makes about 2 threes per game, which is a lot for a big.

note: The experts think ESPN's value of 43 USD is far too high. Yahoo's average cost of 25.3 USD, ESPN's 27.1 and our league's 26 USD last season fit their view better: one expert called 24 USD too cheap and set his price in the mid 20s. He is best in punt FG% builds, since his 44.6% on about 16 attempts is his only weak category. He adds rebounds, points, steals and threes from a big. Early in the season, check whether his three-point shooting recovers and how many rebounds and assists he keeps next to Giannis. Also remember that Miami has only 10 games in our playoff weeks.
